activity.notes: Gustav Eriksson Vasa was recognized as riksföreståndare (Regent/Lord Protector of the Realm) in 1521 during the war against Christian II. He held that office until 6 June 1523, when he was elected King of Sweden. ATLAS records the regency separately from his existing 1523-1560 kingship.

sources.title: När Sverige blev Sverige — Historiska museet
sources.citation_text: The Swedish History Museum lists Gustav Vasa as riksföreståndare from 1521 to 1523 and then as king from 1523 to 1560.

sources.title: Sverige 1523 — Riksarkivet
sources.citation_text: The Swedish National Archives states that the regent Gustav Eriksson Vasa was elected King of Sweden at Strängnäs on 6 June 1523.
